# SYNESIS_E005 — Error

## Description

Project has ONTOLOGY blocks but the template does not declare ONTOLOGY FIELDS.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The project has ONTOLOGY blocks, but the template does not declare any
  field in `ONTOLOGY FIELDS`. Without this, the fields of the
  concepts cannot be validated.
  This problem is in the template definition. If you are not the author
  of the template, tell the project coordinator.
  To fix it, add to the template:
      ONTOLOGY FIELDS
          REQUIRED field_name
      END ONTOLOGY FIELDS
```
